title.fr: Ce que produisent les provinces de l'Atlantique

text.en: In Atlantic Canada, the coasts and the natural resources, such as fishing, farming, forestry and mining, have shaped the region's place in Canada's history.
text.fr: Au Canada atlantique, les côtes et les ressources naturelles, comme la pêche, l'agriculture, la foresterie et les mines, ont façonné la place de la région dans l'histoire du Canada.

source.quote: Atlantic Canada’s coasts and natural resources, including fishing, farming, forestry and mining

verification.evidence: Atlantic Canada’s coasts and natural resources, including fishing, farming, forestry and mining, have made these provinces an important part of Canada’s history and development.

text.en: Today, in Newfoundland and Labrador, taking oil and gas from under the sea makes up a large part of the economy.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, à Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador, l'extraction du pétrole et du gaz en mer représente une part importante de l'économie.

source.quote: Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy.

verification.evidence: Newfoundland and Labrador … Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy.

text.en: Labrador also has a huge supply of hydro-electric power.
text.fr: Le Labrador possède aussi d'immenses ressources hydroélectriques.

source.quote: Labrador also has immense hydro-electric resources

verification.evidence: Labrador also has immense hydro-electric resources.

text.en: Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) is the smallest province. It is known for its beaches, its red soil and its farming.
text.fr: L'Île-du-Prince-Édouard (Î.-P.-É.) est la plus petite province. Elle est connue pour ses plages, sa terre rouge et son agriculture.

source.quote: Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) is the smallest province, known for its beaches, red soil and agriculture

verification.evidence: Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) is the smallest province, known for its beaches, red soil and agriculture

text.en: For a long time, Nova Scotia's economy has included coal mining, forestry and farming.
text.fr: Depuis longtemps, l'économie de la Nouvelle-Écosse comprend l'extraction du charbon, la foresterie et l'agriculture.

source.quote: Nova Scotia has a long history of coal mining, forestry and agriculture

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia has a long history of coal mining, forestry and agriculture.

text.en: Nova Scotia's identity is tied to building ships, to fishing and to shipping.
text.fr: L'identité de la Nouvelle-Écosse est liée à la construction navale, aux pêches et au transport maritime.

source.quote: the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. Known for the world’s highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping.

text.en: Halifax, the capital of Nova Scotia, is Canada's biggest port on the east coast. Its waters are deep and do not freeze.
text.fr: Halifax, la capitale de la Nouvelle-Écosse, est le plus grand port de la côte est du Canada. Ses eaux sont profondes et ne gèlent pas.

source.quote: As Canada’s largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia … As Canada’s largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada’s largest naval base.

text.en: In New Brunswick, the main industries are forestry, farming, fisheries, mining, food processing and tourism.
text.fr: Au Nouveau-Brunswick, les principales industries sont la foresterie, l'agriculture, les pêches, les mines, la transformation des aliments et le tourisme.

source.quote: Forestry, agriculture, fisheries, mining, food processing and tourism are the principal industries.

verification.evidence: New Brunswick … Forestry, agriculture, fisheries, mining, food processing and tourism are the principal industries.

text.en: Saint John is New Brunswick's biggest city. It is also the province's largest port and its largest centre for manufacturing.
text.fr: Saint John est la plus grande ville du Nouveau-Brunswick. C'est aussi le plus grand port et le plus grand centre manufacturier de la province.

source.quote: Saint John is the largest city, port and manufacturing centre

verification.evidence: New Brunswick … Forestry, agriculture, fisheries, mining, food processing and tourism are the principal industries. Saint John is the largest city, port and manufacturing centre;
